requiredFiles.description: Shared types file used by both frontend and backend

criteria: At least 3 React components are migrated to TypeScript (.tsx) with typed props — no component accepts untyped props
At least 2 Express route files are migrated to TypeScript (.ts) with typed Request and Response objects
The 'any' type is not used anywhere in the codebase — tsc --noEmit passes without errors
A shared src/types.ts file defines at least 2 interfaces or types that are imported and used by both the frontend and backend
The TypeScript compiler is configured with strict: true or at least noImplicitAny: true in tsconfig.json
